description: A literal too large for the exponent range evaluates to positive infinity without an error
notes: The spec requires an error when a number in source can't be represented, whether it counts as an integer (as its value does) or as a non-integer that overflows. cty.ParseNumberVal uses math/big's ParseFloat, which scales the mantissa by 5^700000000 and, when the result's exponent passes math/big's range, turns it into infinity without an error (Float.setExpAndRound), so hashicorp/hcl evaluates the literal to positive infinity.
